$comment: Expectations derived from merged upgrade diffs and independent scripts-off installations with the repository TypeScript 5.9.3, before running Uptide. Both parents pass tsc. See RESEARCH.md for root-cause grouping, helper-resolution artifacts, and excluded repositories. Configuration/rename expectations deliberately remain false negatives until the engine supports them.

repos.why: App Router, one package; parent tsc clean with scripts disabled. Upgrade c8ea51cdd1c2604e0ad0f7f2420e7e07160a85fa. Independent target tsc has ten revalidation errors. Middleware rename uses the OLD path, not the truth helper new-path artifact. Image priority is grouped at its shared wrapper, with three downstream uses. Static-generation helpers are two root causes, not every reformatted line.
